name: Momentum burst out of a tight base
note: Bonde's momentum burst, with the bar-count exit that is the point of it: time_stop=3. A range-expansion bar out of a volatility contraction, on heavy volume, closing in the top quartile of its own range, with the previous bar not already running. SCALE NOTE: Bonde's 4% / $0.90 move and 15% base width are DAILY calibrations and are unreachable on intraday bars (SPY's 99.9th-percentile 5-minute move is 0.32%), so the two size conditions are expressed against the base's own geometry instead: the bar must gain at least exp_mult times the mean (high-low)/close of the 20-bar base, and the base's own range must be no more than tight of the 80-bar range containing it. Everything else (volume multiple, top-quartile close, prior-bar cap, minimum price, 3-bar exit) is literal.
source: Pradeep Bonde, Stockbee -- 'Momentum Burst' / '4% breakout' method, taught free at stockbee.blogspot.com and on his YouTube channel. Thresholds corroborated by github.com/ZihaoGuan/ticker-screener, src/stockbee_momentum_burst_screen.py (FOUR_PCT_THRESHOLD=4.0, DOLLAR_THRESHOLD=0.90, MIN_VOLUME=100000, MIN_PRICE=5.0, MIN_BASE_DAYS=3, MAX_BASE_DAYS=20, MAX_BASE_WIDTH_PCT=15.0, MAX_PRIOR_AVG_RANGE_PCT=5.0, MAX_PREV_DAY_GAIN_FOR_RANGE=2.0).

def family_init(ctx):
    bars = ctx.bars
    N = len(bars)
    h = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    l = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    v = [float(b.get("v") or 0.0) for b in bars]
    bn = max(3, int(ctx.p.base_n))
    ln = max(bn + 5, int(ctx.p.long_n))
    vn = max(5, int(ctx.p.vol_n))

    rp = [0.0] * N
    for j in range(N):
        rp[j] = (h[j] - l[j]) / c[j] if c[j] > 0 else 0.0
    arng = [None] * N
    s = 0.0
    for j in range(N):
        s += rp[j]
        if j >= bn:
            s -= rp[j - bn]
        if j >= bn - 1:
            arng[j] = s / bn
    vsm = [None] * N
    s = 0.0
    for j in range(N):
        s += v[j]
        if j >= vn:
            s -= v[j - vn]
        if j >= vn - 1:
            vsm[j] = s / vn

    ctx.arng = ctx.series(arng, "base_avg_range")
    ctx.vsm = ctx.series(vsm, "vol_sma")
    ctx.db = ctx.indicator("donchian", period=bn)
    ctx.dl = ctx.indicator("donchian", period=ln)


def signal(ctx, i):
    if i < 3:
        return 0
    cn = ctx.c[i]
    c1 = ctx.c[i - 1]
    c2 = ctx.c[i - 2]
    if cn is None or c1 is None or c2 is None or c1 <= 0 or c2 <= 0:
        return 0
    if cn < ctx.p.min_px:
        return 0
    ar = ctx.arng[i - 1]
    vs = ctx.vsm[i - 1]
    bh = ctx.db.upper[i - 1]
    bl = ctx.db.lower[i - 1]
    lh = ctx.dl.upper[i - 1]
    ll = ctx.dl.lower[i - 1]
    if ar is None or vs is None or bh is None or bl is None:
        return 0
    if lh is None or ll is None or ar <= 0 or vs <= 0 or ll <= 0 or bl <= 0:
        return 0
    thr = float(ctx.p.exp_mult) * ar
    if thr <= 0:
        return 0
    if cn / c1 - 1.0 < thr:
        return 0
    if c1 / c2 - 1.0 >= float(ctx.p.prev_frac) * thr:
        return 0
    if ctx.v[i] < float(ctx.p.vol_mult) * vs:
        return 0
    lw = (lh - ll) / ll
    if lw <= 0:
        return 0
    bw = (bh - bl) / bl
    if bw > float(ctx.p.tight) * lw:
        return 0
    rng = ctx.h[i] - ctx.l[i]
    if rng > 0 and cn < ctx.l[i] + float(ctx.p.cl_q) * rng:
        return 0
    return 1
